mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION WHERE TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID = #{teacherStudentAccessId} AND ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION ( STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION_ID, STUDENT_ID, TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID, SESSION_TOKEN_HASH, SESSION_STATUS, EXPIRES_AT, ABSOLUTE_EXPIRES_AT, LAST_ACCESSED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{studentAccessSessionId}, #{studentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{teacherStudentAccessId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{sessionTokenHash}, #{sessionStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.yunki.lessonpt.common.mybatis.typehandler.StudentAccessSessionStatusTypeHandler}, #{expiresAt}, #{absoluteExpiresAt}, #{lastAccessedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION SET SESSION_STATUS = 'REVOKED', REVOKED_AT = #{revokedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID = #{teacherStudentAccessId} AND SESSION_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND REVOKED_AT IS NULL

UPDATE TB_STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION SET SESSION_STATUS = 'REVOKED', REVOKED_AT = #{revokedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE SESSION_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND REVOKED_AT IS NULL AND TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID IN ( SELECT TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID FROM TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS WHERE TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = #{teacherStudentId} )

UPDATE TB_STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION SET SESSION_STATUS = 'REVOKED', REVOKED_AT = #{revokedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE SESSION_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND REVOKED_AT IS NULL AND TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID IN ( SELECT access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID FROM TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS access_row JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT relation ON relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID WHERE relation.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} )

UPDATE TB_STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION SET SESSION_STATUS = 'REVOKED', REVOKED_AT = #{revokedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION_ID = #{studentAccessSessionId} AND SESSION_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND REVOKED_AT IS NULL

UPDATE TB_STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION SET EXPIRES_AT = #{expiresAt}, LAST_ACCESSED_AT = #{lastAccessedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE STUDENT_ACCESS_SESSION_ID = #{studentAccessSessionId} AND SESSION_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND REVOKED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRES_AT <= ABSOLUTE_EXPIRES_AT
